name: Local operations - hourly CSV refresh and reminders

nodes.name: Hourly Manila schedule
nodes.notes: Inactive reference export. Select outgoing credentials, verify locally, and deliberately activate before scheduling. Schedule uses Asia/Manila workflow timezone.

nodes.name: Refresh configured CSV files
nodes.notes: Select outgoing HTTP Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <OPERATIONS_API_TOKEN>. Run n8n on the API host. Refresh uses the API's --files folder, not a client-supplied path. HTTP failures stop the workflow.

nodes.name: Require all sources accepted
nodes.notes: Operational CSV rejections use HTTP 200 with rejected/partial JSON status. Stop here so a failed refresh never silently proceeds to scheduled reminders.

nodes.name: Record reminders and daily summary
nodes.notes: Select the same outgoing HTTP Header Auth credential. Records local notifications only; no external messages are sent. HTTP failures stop execution.
